title: Syzygium cumini (L.) skeels mitigate diabetic nephropathy by regulating Nrf2 pathway and mitocyhondrial dysfunction: In vitro and in vivo studies.
authors: Bangar, Nilima S; Dixit, Aditi; Apte, Mayura M; Tupe, Rashmi S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物药对糖尿病肾病的保护作用，涉及Nrf2通路和分子对接，但核心是药物疗效而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL PREVALENCE: Hyperglycemia in diabetes increases the generation of advanced glycation end products (AGEs) through non-enzymatic reactions. The interaction between AGEs and their receptors (RAGE) leads to oxidative and inflammatory stress, which plays a pivotal role in developing diabetic nephropathy. Syzygium cumini (SC) L. (DC.) homeopathic preparations viz. 200C, 30C, and mother tincture [MT] are used to treat diabetes. This study aimed to elucidate the regulatory effects of SC preparations (200C, 30C, and MT) on the nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) - nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) pathways and mitochondrial dysfunction in mitigating diabetic nephropathy (DN). MATERIALS AND METHODS: Streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats were treated with SC preparations (200C, 30C, MT; 1:20 dilution in distilled water; 600 muL/kg body weight) and metformin (45 mg/kg body weight) twice daily for 40 days. DN was evaluated through biochemical parameters and histological examination. Renal tissue lysates were analyzed for glycation markers. Protein and gene levels of Nrf2, NF-kappaB, and mitochondrial dysfunctional signaling were determined via western blotting and RT-qPCR. An immunohistochemical analysis of the kidneys was performed. In vitro, human serum albumin (HSA - 10 mg/ml) was glycated with methylglyoxal (MGO - 55 mM) in the presence of SC preparations (200C, 30C, MT) for eight days. Glycated samples (400 mug/mL) were incubated with renal cells (HEK-293) for 24 h. Further reactive oxygen species production, Nrf2 nuclear translocation, and protein or gene expression of Nrf2 and apoptosis markers were analyzed by western blotting, RT-qPCR, and flow cytometry. Molecular docking of gallic and ellagic acid with the HSA-MGO complex was performed. RESULT: In vivo experiments using streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats treated with SC preparations exhibited improved biochemical parameters, preserved kidney function, and reduced glycation adduct formation in a dose-dependent manner. Furthermore, SC preparations downregulated inflammatory mediators such as RAGE, NF-kappaB, vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), and Tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha) while upregulating the Nrf2-dependent antioxidant and detoxification pathways. They downregulated B-cell lymphoma 2 (Bcl-2) associated X-protein (BAX), C/EBP homologous protein (CHOP), Dynamin-related protein 1 (DRP1), and upregulated BCL 2 gene expression. Notably, SC preparations facilitated nuclear translocation of Nrf2, leading to the upregulation of antioxidant enzymes and the downregulation of oxidative stress markers. Molecular docking studies revealed favorable interactions between gallic (-5.26 kcal/mol) and ellagic acid (-4.71 kcal/mol) with the HSA-MGO complex. CONCLUSION: SC preparations mitigate renal cell apoptosis and mitochondrial dysfunction through Nrf2-dependent mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学背景：糖尿病中的高血糖通过非酶促反应增加晚期糖基化终末产物（AGEs）的生成。AGEs与其受体（RAGE）之间的相互作用导致氧化和炎症应激，这在糖尿病肾病的发生中起关键作用。蒲桃（Syzygium cumini, SC）L. (DC.) 的顺势疗法制剂，即200C、30C和母酊剂（MT），用于治疗糖尿病。本研究旨在阐明SC制剂（200C、30C和MT）对核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）-核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）通路及线粒体功能障碍的调节作用，以缓解糖尿病肾病（DN）。材料与方法：链脲佐菌素诱导的糖尿病大鼠接受SC制剂（200C、30C、MT；以蒸馏水1:20稀释；600 μL/kg体重）和二甲双胍（45 mg/kg体重）治疗，每日两次，持续40天。通过生化参数和组织学检查评估DN。肾组织裂解液用于分析糖基化标志物。通过蛋白质印迹和RT-qPCR测定Nrf2、NF-kappaB及线粒体功能障碍信号传导的蛋白质和基因水平。对肾脏进行免疫组织化学分析。在体外，人血清白蛋白（HSA - 10 mg/mL）在SC制剂（200C、30C、MT）存在下与甲基乙二醛（MGO - 55 mM）糖基化8天。糖基化样本（400 μg/mL）与肾细胞（HEK-293）孵育24小时。进一步通过蛋白质印迹、RT-qPCR和流式细胞术分析活性氧产生、Nrf2核转位以及Nrf2和凋亡标志物的蛋白质或基因表达。对没食子酸和鞣花酸与HSA-MGO复合物进行分子对接。结果：使用链脲佐菌素诱导的糖尿病大鼠进行的体内实验显示，SC制剂治疗改善了生化参数，保护了肾功能，并以剂量依赖性方式减少了糖基化加合物的形成。此外，SC制剂下调了炎症介质，如RAGE、NF-kappaB、血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）和肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-alpha），同时上调了Nrf2依赖性抗氧化和解毒通路。它们下调了B细胞淋巴瘤2（Bcl-2）相关X蛋白（BAX）、C/EBP同源蛋白（CHOP）、动力相关蛋白1（DRP1），并上调了BCL2基因表达。值得注意的是，SC制剂促进了Nrf2的核转位，导致抗氧化酶上调并下调氧化应激标志物。分子对接研究显示没食子酸（-5.26 kcal/mol）和鞣花酸（-4.71 kcal/mol）与HSA-MGO复合物之间存在有利相互作用。结论：SC制剂通过Nrf2依赖性机制减轻肾细胞凋亡和线粒体功能障碍。
